caption: A handful of dry pine needles is fed to a small fire, and they crackle and flare up brightly before the flames settle.

sa.check: A handful of dry pine needles is dropped onto it.
The drop comes first and the flare follows.

pc.expect: The flare comes as the needles land and dies back to the size the fire was, and the needles only char to ash.
pc.fail: The flare comes before the needles land; or ash gathers back into whole needles; or the flare dies back and rises again with nothing added; or the flare keeps growing for the rest of the clip.

pc.expect: The flare rises upward from the fire and the ash and fragments settle down.
pc.fail: The flare points downward into the fire pit; or the needles are blown upward and stay aloft as they burn; or the ash rises and stays in the air; or the flames hang below the wood.

pc.expect: The needles catch where they land on the flames and the flare comes from that spot.
pc.fail: The needles land and nothing flares at all; or the flare rises from a part of the fire where no needles landed; or the needles sit in the flames and stay pale and whole to the end of the clip.

pc.expect: The needles are fine dry stalks that curl, blacken and crumble, and the fire's logs stay solid.
pc.fail: A needle melts and drips; or the needles stay straight and pale while glowing; or the needles fuse into one lump; or a log flows like a liquid.

pc.expect: The needles that were dropped are the needles that burn, and the fire's logs keep their number.
pc.fail: The needles vanish in mid-air before landing; or new needles appear on the fire with none dropped; or a log vanishes; or a needle passes through a log and out below.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The fire's stones, the ground and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The stones rearrange; or the ground changes texture; or the background changes between frames.

note: The crackle is sound and is not judged. Who feeds the fire is not judged.
